prerequisites: Basic skills in machine learning and statistics, for example, courses CS-C3240 Machine Learning, and MS-A0503 First Course in Probability and Statistics.

learning_outcomes.text: You know general principles and concepts of machine learning, especially neural networks and deep learning, and their most essential methods
You can apply the learned in some real world problems in applications of information technology, especially of speech technology, signal processing and communications
You can describe problems of machine learning in speech technology, signal processing and communications

syllabus_topics: Machine learning methods and applications in speech technology, signal processing and communications
